checkpoint.title: Viridian's Mart: potions before the rival on Route 22

events.why: out of the Center and along the street to the Mart's door, in and up to the counter, facing the clerk (as 02.03)

Potions up to 4 in the bag, as in PokeGuy's bag at the Route 22 rival (potion x4, superpotion x4, xaccuracy x4, xspecial x17, xspeed x5, guardspec x2; PokemonSimulation docs/battles/pokeguy-conditions.md); the Super Potions are 12.01's. Early in the row, so a failed purchase stops it before the walk. Buys 4 less what the bag holds, skipped at 4

an Antidote and 2 Parlyz Heals for the League's poison and paralysis (user's decision 2026-11-15, from the shopping audit): PokeGuy's bag at the Route 22 rival and at Lorelei holds antidote x1 and parlyzheal x2 (PokemonSimulation docs/battles/pokeguy-conditions.md), which the story's bag never bought for the League; recovery_items() cures PSN and PAR with them. Viridian sells both (ANTIDOTE 100, PARLYZ HEAL 200: 500 in all); its own step, as buy_potions's fill_to would skip a whole step when the bag holds 4 Potions. Bought blind after 17.04's Giovanni prize

checkpoint: Starts at Viridian's nurse, where 17.04b ends. The Mart's clerk is first in the checkpoint: the potions are bought before the rival, and 19.01 starts in the Mart with the bag as it should be.
Ends in the Viridian Mart at (4, 3) facing the clerk, where 19.01 starts.
